pedal: Boss RT-2 Rotary Ensemble — reamps of the guitar DI dataset (stereo: Output A and B)
note: Effect on. Set the outer ring of knob 1 twice: Drive Knob toggle to BALANCE, ring to 12:00 (Balance centre); then toggle to DRIVE, ring to 7:00 (no Drive). Leave the toggle on DRIVE for the whole run. LED green = rotors slow, red = fast: hold the RT-2's own pedal to change it, then give the rotors ~10 s.

rig.note: Boss RT-2 on its 9 V adapter: the guitar DI dataset. Input from interface out 3; OUTPUT A -> input 2, OUTPUT B -> input 1; INST, AIR off, pad on, gain fully counter-clockwise.
